reactions.description: Cleavage of nisin precursor peptide (prepeptide) by recognizing the GASPR cleavage site. Presence of lantionine-rings is essential for cleavage in vivo, but not strictly necessary in vitro.
Cleavage of nisin A precursor peptide, resulting in mature and bioactive nisin A.
